objectives.description: Identify internal and external computer components including motherboard, CPU, RAM, hard disk, and power supply unit
Describe the functions of computer storage devices including hard disk, SSD, flash drives, and memory cards
Assemble a basic computer system step by step following safe hardware procedures
Perform preventive maintenance on computers including cleaning, updates, and hardware checks
Troubleshoot common motherboard and hardware problems and describe appropriate solutions
Replace and upgrade RAM, hard disk, and other internal components following correct procedures

subStrands.name: Mobile Phone Systems and Fault Diagnosis

objectives.description: Describe GSM network generations (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G) and explain how mobile phones connect to networks
Identify common GSM phone faults including screen damage, battery failure, speaker and charging port issues
Safely replace GSM phone components including battery, screen, keypad, and charging port
Describe GSM operating systems (Android, iOS) and explain the process of software flashing and OS updates
Perform phone software upgrades, factory resets, and data backup and recovery operations
Identify soldering tools and equipment and describe correct safety procedures for soldering
Demonstrate soldering technique by joining simple circuit connections correctly
Describe methods of power management in computers and mobile devices to preserve battery and device life
Perform routine preventive maintenance on computers and GSM devices to extend their operational life
Apply basic bookkeeping to track income, expenses, and profit in a small repair business
Describe marketing strategies for attracting and retaining customers in a computer and GSM repair business
Demonstrate professional customer service skills including communication, transparency, and warranty practices
Perform a complete phone or computer repair project demonstrating diagnosis, repair, testing, and handover skills
